metric: Cross entropy in nats per byte; four overlapping validation tilings, not independent test sets.
timing_note: ms_per_step and training_targets_per_second retain raw recorded training_seconds. Runs flagged suspended_for_mixed_screen may include scheduler suspension in those times and must not be used as active-speed estimates. No pause duration is silently subtracted. Final controlled timing is in final_checks/speed_results.json.
